answer_verification.reasoning: The 70 degree angle AOC is bisected by OM, so angle MOC=35 degrees. The source marks angle MON as a right angle (90 degrees). Since C lies between M and N in that right angle, angle CON=90-35=55 degrees, choice B, matching the source GT.
